mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear 60 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. If you look to the skies starting at 9:11 PM, you can spot the space station moving from the Cross Plains area toward Madison near Home Depot for four minutes. The overnight low will hit 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Regarding city news, officers were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way on September 10th for a burglary in progress. A suspect was located with a handgun after a report of a gunshot, but no injuries were sustained. The suspect is now in custody at the Dane County Jail.

We have plenty happening in town. Today features the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival, along with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is a yoga class at Insight Wellness, followed by a busy week with trivia at Hop Haus, the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market.

On September 10th, Verona police responded to a reported burglary in progress. A 19-year-old male was taken into custody after a handgun was recovered at the scene. He is being charged with burglary and recklessly endangering safety.
Today's flavor of the day is Really Reese's. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
